nodes.label:
Mentor Observes a
Student in Session
nodes.title: Mentor Observes a Student in Session
nodes.info: The mentor's own week-to-week observation -- what a student enjoys, what they get stuck on. Never a stored profile.

nodes.label:
Mentor Forms a
Mental Model
nodes.title: Mentor Forms a Mental Model
nodes.info: A working picture in the mentor's head: 'this student responds well to music-themed examples.'

nodes.label:
Mentor Requests a
Specific Customization
nodes.title: Mentor Requests a Specific Customization
nodes.info: A detailed prompt naming exactly what should change -- pacing, analogy, difficulty -- following the specificity habit from Chapter 32's prompt engineering section.

nodes.label:
AI Agent Drafts the
Customized Lesson
nodes.title: AI Agent Drafts the Customized Lesson
nodes.info: The agent produces a revised card or lesson, keeping the underlying concept the same.

nodes.label:
Mentor Reviews
the Draft
nodes.title: Mentor Reviews the Draft
nodes.info: The same human-in-the-loop review Chapter 32 required for every AI-drafted output, applied here to a lesson instead of a message.

nodes.label:
Customized Lesson
Used With the Student
nodes.title: Customized Lesson Used With the Student
nodes.info: The version that actually reaches the student -- always mentor-approved, never sent straight from the agent.
